Develop a sleek Footer component including copyright information and social media links. Apply dark-mode and glassmorphism aesthetics, utilizing framer-motion for subtle hover or entrance animations.
Set up global dark-mode styles, base fonts, and fundamental CSS variables or utility classes for glassmorphism effects and overall aesthetic consistency across the application.

Assemble the main application layout, importing and rendering the Hero and Footer components. Establish the overall dark-mode and glassmorphism theme, ensuring a cohesive single-page experience with framer-motion layout transitions or element animations where appropriate.
